title: R6: Live runs: labels-only, stakeholder, shuffled, noisy; S start, F ceiling (initiative cap ~$10)
description:
## Purpose

Live runs on the chosen dataset.

## Arms

- labels-only (analyst sees which items were wrong, no reasons);
- simulated-stakeholder explanations (R4);
- SHUFFLED explanations (attached to wrong items: shows content matters);
- noisy stakeholder (~20% vague/wrong);
- starting point S (one-line rubric) and F (excerpted full guideline) as ceiling.

Rounds of 10-20 explained errors from the pool; scored on dev each round; final slice only after an owner go.

## Metric

Fraction of the S-to-F gap recovered (macro-F1) per arm per round, and number of explanations needed to reach it; paired bootstrap CIs; per-class recall; UNEXPLAINABLE rate (label-noise estimate).

## Stops

Stage it (round 1 -> owner look -> remaining rounds -> owner go -> final slice). Fresh ledger per stage; `--max-new-requests` = printed bound; circuit breaker on.

## Definition of done

All arms scored on the final slice; text-free results committed; comment with the table.

## Cost

**Cap ~$10 for the whole initiative** (R3 + R6 Jev, stakeholder and analyst calls).
